_comment: End-to-end demo: multi-provider labels for aggregate.by_model only (no API keys, no live LLM calls). Scenarios: grounded answer, safe refusal, hallucination with evidence, over-refusal, fabrication on unanswerable questions.

cases.question: What step does RAG perform before generating an answer?
cases.answer: RAG retrieves relevant passages from a knowledge base before generating an answer.

evidence.text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation first retrieves relevant passages from a corpus or knowledge base, then conditions the generator on that evidence to produce the final answer.

cases.question: Why is grounding important for enterprise RAG deployments?
cases.answer: Grounding ties answers to verifiable sources so teams can audit responses and reduce unchecked fabrication.

evidence.text: Enterprise RAG emphasizes grounding: answers should cite verifiable sources so stakeholders can audit outputs and mitigate unchecked hallucinations.
